title: Sand Dollar Manor | KEY.co
description_expanded: Prominence is nestled within one of the most sought-after communities along 30A, offering an idyllic retreat with its stunning amenities and lush open green spaces. This luxurious haven provides easy access to over seventeen miles of picturesque bike paths, perfect for leisurely rides or invigorating runs. Its prime location places guests close to both new and beloved 30A spots, ensuring endless exploration and enjoyment. The community's town center is a vibrant hub, while two resort-style pools offer a refreshing oasis for relaxation and fun. Every aspect of Prominence is designed to inspire and delight, from its charming town center to the pristine white beaches of Scenic 30A just a short distance away. The blend of modern convenience and natural beauty creates an unparalleled vacation experience. Whether lounging by the pools, exploring local eateries and shops, or biking through scenic paths, Prominence promises a perfect balance of luxury and leisure. It's more than a vacation spot; it's a gateway to unforgettable memories and serene coastal living.

Features: Indoor Dryer Washer TV Internet Deck
Parking information- Parking for 3 Cars and 2 Golf Carts.
